paper.title: TopoEvo: A Topology-Aware Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Framework for Root Cause Analysis in Microservices
paper.central_claim: MOMA+拓扑VQ词表+HET agent诊断与层级incident memory/TTA共同提高微服务根因定位、分类并适应拓扑漂移。

provenance.notes: 环境声明gpt-6.1-sol，无独立runtime receipt/session标识；不探测。仅固定材料独立初评。

sections_read: 全文3243行，§I–VI、TableI–II、Fig1–7标题/正文、全部公式；固定版本不含附录或page_images

evidence.support_explanation: 具体非平稳环境下的知识留存需求。

evidence.quote: stores solved incidents as compact records consisting of candidate-centric topology fingerprints, symptom-token sets, validated hypotheses with key evidence, and mitigation outcomes.
evidence.support_explanation: 非权重incident memory明确保留诊断和处理结果，范围内B类组件；未明确后续检索接口和效用准入。

evidence.quote: Updates follow a hierarchical policy: pod-level patterns are refreshed more aggressively than service- and node-level patterns, stabilizing slow-changing infrastructure knowledge while tracking fast-changing deployment dynamics.
evidence.support_explanation: 按pod/service/node变化率维护，Eq19相似项随机淘汰；未给具体速率和阈值。

evidence.quote: During deployment, high-confidence diagnoses (strong support, low missingness, and consistent topology constraints) are treated as pseudo-labeled samples and accumulated in a buffer
evidence.support_explanation: SEM还含权重TTA；w/o SEM不能单独认证非权重memory的保留收益。

evidence.quote: All subsequent reasoning and tool queries are restricted to this subgraph, while nodes outside it are masked to prevent distraction by weakly related services.
evidence.support_explanation: 候选hop子图硬限制，结构先验可执行；GAT topK漏真因会不可恢复。

evidence.quote: For each hypothesis, the judge checks temporal precedence (whether the proposed root cause becomes abnormal no later than downstream symptoms within a slack), path consistency (whether evidence is located along the hypothesized route and consistent with the dependency graph), and template consistency (whether the collected evidence matches the intended failure template under strict/relaxed criteria to handle partial observability).
evidence.support_explanation: 图和时间约束是诊断验证而非干预因果证明；slack、strict/relaxed阈值未详报。
B Top1 75.66 vs TAMO72.22；Top3 79.80弱于TAMO80.55。正文称B TAMO更强Top1与表矛盾。
正文B full71.90→63.90与表II75.66→63.28不一致，不能混用或猜作不同实验。

evidence.quote: For all LLM-based components, GPT-4o-2024-11-20 is used as the backbone model to ensure consistent reasoning ability across different settings.
evidence.support_explanation: 统一LLM及A100/256GB/两层8头、lr=.001、K128实现信息；无种子/分割/样本数和成本结果。

evidence.quote: For efficiency, we measure end-to-end diagnosis latency (wall-clock time per incident, including agent/tool calls when applicable).
evidence.support_explanation: 定义拟测latency，但完整结果无latency/tokens/维护/TTA成本数表。

evidence.quote: In future work, we plan to (1) strengthen causal validation beyond topology-consistent verification (e.g., intervention-aware checks), (2) design safer and more cost-aware continual adaptation policies under drift, and (3) extend evaluation to more heterogeneous microservice platforms and observability conditions.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者承认拓扑一致不等于因果验证，以及成本和安全未闭合。

evidence.quote: is a tool-assisted LLM-agent framework for fine-grained RCA that integrates multimodal alignment and model tools (e.g., localization/classification tools) to support root-cause analysis in cloud-native systems.
evidence.support_explanation: TAMO是近邻（仅本文描述），已整合alignment/模型工具；残余须隔离topology tokens/HET/memory。

evidence.quote: stores compact, verifiable pointers to the underlying statistics (KPI identifiers and value bands, template identifiers and burst scores, and interaction-pattern descriptors).
evidence.support_explanation: symptom lexicon的grounding指针，与动态incident memory不同，不可把训练出的lexicon收益全记在RSI。
